chosen_display: 2. Target player draws three cards and loses 3 life.
annotation_description: Targeting the opponent with 'draw 3, lose 3 life' gives the opponent massive card advantage (3 cards) for a trivial 3 damage when they're at 20 life. The UR spells opponent will use those cards to find answers and counterspells. Haiku Hype's hand is full of redundant Requiting Hexes with no targets and an uncastable Doomsday Excruciator - they desperately need to draw cards themselves.

Qwen3 ESPN has a devastating two-creature combo available: Eddymurk Crab costs just UU (8 instants/sorceries in graveyard) and Sunderflock costs just UU (reduced by Crab's MV 7). Together for 4 mana, Sunderflock bounces all non-Elemental creatures including Harvester of Misery, deploying 10 power. With 6 lands, casting both leaves 2 mana for Spell Pierce backup. Casting Sleight of Hand first uses 1 mana, meaning after the cantrip they can still cast both creatures but lose the ability to hold up Spell Pierce.

Using Spell Pierce on a low-impact cantrip (Sleight of Hand) when Qwen3 ESPN is about to deploy major threats like Eddymurk Crab (which costs only UU with 8 instants/sorceries in graveyard) or Sunderflock. Spell Pierce would be much more valuable protecting these threats from removal spells like Archenemy's Charm or other answers.

Eddymurk Crab costs only UU with 10 instants/sorceries in graveyard, provides a 5/5 body, taps opponent's creatures, and critically enables Sunderflock next turn (reducing its cost by 7 as an Elemental) to bounce all non-Elemental creatures. Glacial Dragonhunt is just card filtering.

Chose 'Exile target creature or planeswalker' mode on Archenemy's Charm when the opponent has zero creatures or planeswalkers on the battlefield. The only possible target is their own Harvester of Misery, or the spell fizzles with no legal target. This wastes a powerful BBB spell entirely.

message: Discard a creature card instead of discarding two cards?
annotation_description: With Winternight Stories, the player is discarding 2 non-creature cards instead of discarding 1 creature card (a duplicate Sunderflock). This wastes an extra card for no benefit. They have 2 Sunderflock in hand and only need 1 for the Eddymurk Crab + Sunderflock combo to bounce the opponent's Doomsday Excruciator.

annotation_description: Haiku Hype has lethal on board: Doomsday Excruciator (6/6 flying) + Harvester of Misery (5/4 menace) = 11 damage against opponent at 7 life with no creatures and all lands tapped. Casting Insatiable Avarice mode 2 targeting the opponent gives them 3 cards for only 3 life loss, which is unnecessary and potentially dangerous. The opponent has Eddymurk Crab in their deck which could cost as little as UU with 11 instants/sorceries in graveyard, and one untapped Steam Vents could enable a flash blocker.
